description: Fetches resting order book depth for a Polymarket outcome token (or market slug and outcome name). Returns top 20 bids and asks, midpoint price, spread, depth within 1/2/5 cents, and last trade price. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

outcome.description: Outcome name (e.g. Yes or No) when slug is provided

slug.description: Market slug if tokenId is unknown
